rationale: Both constituent panels of Figure V were produced. Figure5_b.pdf displays an essentially flat green employment-change fit annotated 'Emp. change, slope = 0.006 (0.048)', matching the claim's employment_change_slope=0.006 (s.e. 0.048) exactly. Figure5_a.pdf shows a downward-sloping red missing-jobs fit annotated 'Missing jobs, slope = -0.133 (0.034)' and an upward-sloping blue excess-jobs fit annotated 'Excess jobs, slope = 0.139 (0.057)', matching missing_jobs_slope=-0.133 and excess_jobs_slope=0.139 exactly with the reported standard errors. Both panels share the 'Minimum-to-median wage ratio' (Kaitz) x-axis with data points spanning roughly 0.39-0.54, consistent with the claimed Kaitz range (verification instructions expected ~0.37-0.55). All annotated slopes and standard errors reproduce the paper values to the reported precision, and the visual structure (flat total, declining missing, rising excess) matches the claim.
